name: RuneScape: Dragonwilds
notes: The server won't start without an OwnerId in DedicatedServer.ini. That is your Player ID, from the bottom of the in-game Settings menu. It goes under [/Script/Dominion.DedicatedServerSettings] with ServerName, DefaultWorldName and AdminPassword. On Windows, create the WindowsServer folder and copy the values from Saved\Config\Linux\DedicatedServer.ini. Jagex's guide puts Saved\ in the install folder, but the wiki says %LOCALAPPDATA%\RSDragonwilds\Saved\. Check which one your install uses and fix the paths. Needs 2 GB RAM plus 1 GB per player. A second server uses port 7778.
